audit.why: 49.28% over 3176 games with the page at EVEN / 6/10 and carry threat 7/10. The mirror's reading is that Malphite owns the opening levels because Sett has no way in against a 625-range slow, Sett takes over as Grit and Knuckle Down's max-health damage come online, Malphite spikes at level 6 and his first armour item, and Sett retakes the duel at two-plus items.
audit.corrected: EVEN. His poke levels and his two spikes; your levels 3-5 and your two-item duel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Sett/Sett/Sett/Skill/Sett/Skill/Skill. That gives Sett level 1 against a ranged slow he cannot answer, calls levels 4-5 a coin-flip when the page itself says 'you punish his low-armor early body', and calls level 6 Sett's when whys[4] says his R 'can flip any fight — respect it'. The mirror gives levels 1-2 to Malphite and two-plus items to Sett.
audit.why: Mirror plus the page's own whys[4] and whys[5], which already name Malphite as the owner of level 6 and the first armour item. The tokens were the only part that disagreed.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Malphite / Malphite / Sett / Sett / Malphite / Malphite / Sett in both layers, ratings re-scaled, and the four whys that named the wrong owner rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Granite Shield is never explained, and the page's core advice — 'buy armor pen', 'armor pen + grit' — misreads the matchup. It also gives no cooldowns at all, and Thunderclap's aftershock cone is reduced to 'auto into his W'.
audit.why: Granite Shield absorbs damage up to 10% of his MAX HEALTH and recharges out of combat, so the first hit of every trade is free for him and armour penetration does nothing about it — you have to pop it and keep hitting. Q is a flat 8s at 625 range and steals move speed. E is a flat 7s and its damage scales with his ARMOUR, so his armour items are offensive. R is 130s at rank 1 with 1000 range against your R's 400.
audit.corrected: Pop Granite Shield (10% max HP, recharges out of combat) before you cash grit. Q flat 8s / 625, E flat 7s and scales off his armour, R 130s at rank 1 from 1000 range.

edits.before: Double-punch passive makes you the strongest level-1 auto-trader in the lane. Punish Malphite on every CS, but respect his opening tool — chips now, all-ins later.
edits.after: Seismic Shard is a flat 8s at 625 range and steals your move speed, so level 1 is his — you have no way in. Soak the wave and bank his poke as grit instead.

edits.before: Q gives move speed toward Malphite and two empowered punches. Take short Q trades and back off before he can answer with Unstoppable Force.
edits.after: Still his at 2: Granite Shield eats 10% of his max health and recharges out of combat, so single punches achieve nothing. Wait for Facebreaker.

edits.before: Q ranks make your punch trades heavier, but Malphite has his core tools too. Keep the grit bar honest: trade in, W-shield his return damage, out.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are yours: Knuckle Down's max-health damage beats a rock body, so trade once Granite Shield is popped and before Sunfire lands.

edits.before: The Show Stopper online — you can start fights Malphite doesn't want. Suplex him into your wave or tower, never into his own minions.
edits.after: Level 6 is his — Unstoppable Force arrives from 1000 range while your R reaches 400. Hold yours as the answer and never fight with his up.

edits.before: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: matchup-defining — Saved for fights. Lane is fine without it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Unstoppable Force (R): 130s at rank 1, 1000 range. - Seismic Shard (Q): flat 8s. - Ground Slam (E): flat 7s.

edits.before: That is Malphite's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Thunderclap turns his autos into an aftershock cone on 10s — step out and wait.

edits.before: You out-trade a mana-starved Malphite at level 1 with Q and passive sustain.
edits.after: Malphite's 625-range Q steals your move speed before you can reach him.

edits.before: At level 2 he still only has Q poke while your all-in threat grows.
edits.after: Level 2 is still his — no gap-close yet, and his Q slows you off.

notes: The page's headline advice is wrong and I could not fix it inside the length band: tldr, winCon and report[1] all say 'buy armor pen'. Ground Slam's damage scales with his ARMOUR and Granite Shield is a flat 10%-max-health absorb — neither is answered by penetration, and Knuckle Down's max-health damage is what actually beats him. Those three fields want a rewrite by whoever can change them together. Mirror facts restated rather than re-derived: Facebreaker only stuns with enemies on OPPOSITE sides of Sett (keep your back clear of the wave or it is a slow), and only the CENTRE of Haymaker is true damage — the sides are physical, so 'armour won't reduce it' is wrong. Both still absent from Sett's page. I followed the mirror over the packet on rows 0-1, where the packet says Sett and the mirror says Malphite.
